units.title_th: ทักทายและคำสุภาพ
units.goal_th: ทักทาย ถามสารทุกข์ ขอบคุณ ขอโทษ บอกลาพร้อมคำอวยพร และขอให้อีกฝ่ายพูดซ้ำได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, Nam's Canadian friend, whom Nam meets on campus in the morning and again later in the day. Nam must greet her for the time of day, ask how she is, thank her and apologize, ask her to repeat something she didn't catch (Pardon?), and say goodbye with a good wish.

lessons.topic: Saying goodbye with a good wish
lessons.grammar: Nice to meet you (first time) vs Nice to see you (again); replying with You too.

lessons.topic: Short replies: Pardon? No problem. Me too.
lessons.grammar: one-word and two-word replies; Pardon? to ask again; Welcome! (ยินดีต้อนรับ) vs You're welcome.

units.title_th: เสียงที่คนไทยมักพูดผิด
units.goal_th: ฟังแยกและออกเสียง th, v/w, r/l, s/sh/ch สระสั้น-ยาว และเสียงท้ายคำ (l, z, d, ng) ได้ชัดขึ้น
units.scenario: B is Mr. Brown running a short pronunciation check. He says one word from a pair (think/sink, ship/sheep, tell/ten, bed/bet); Nam must say which word she heard and repeat both words clearly, including the final sounds.

lessons.topic: Short and long vowels: ship / sheep, live / leave, sit / seat
lessons.grammar: minimal pairs ɪ / iː; listen-text with the other word of each pair as the option

lessons.topic: Final sounds: tell / ten, rise / rice, bed / bet, thin / thing
lessons.grammar: word-final l vs n (tell vs en.ten), z vs s (rise vs en.rice), d vs t, n vs ng; listen-text options as pairs

units.title_th: แนะนำตัว
units.goal_th: บอกชื่อ ชื่อเล่น ประเทศ เมืองที่อยู่ และว่าเป็นนักศึกษา ถามข้อมูลเดียวกันจากคนอื่น และขอให้พูดช้า ๆ ได้
units.scenario: B is an exchange student at a university welcome party. Nam must say her name and nickname, where she is from and where she lives, that she is a student, ask him the same questions, and ask him to speak slowly when she does not understand.

lessons.grammar: present simple I / you with live: Where do you live? — I live in Bangkok.

lessons.topic: First name, last name and nickname
lessons.grammar: Mr. / Ms. + last name; Call me + nickname

units.title_th: ตัวเลขและอายุ
units.goal_th: นับเลข 0–20 บอกเบอร์โทรศัพท์ ถามว่ามีกี่คนหรือกี่อัน และถามตอบเรื่องอายุได้
units.scenario: B is a staff member at a university club sign-up table. Nam must say how many people are in her group, give her phone number digit by digit, and say her age and her younger sister's age.

lessons.grammar: How many + plural noun? (How many people?); number + plural -s; A table for two, please.
irregular plural child → children; He's young.

units.title_th: ครอบครัว
units.goal_th: แนะนำคนในครอบครัว บอกว่ามีพี่น้อง สามีภรรยา หรือลูกไหม และพูดถึงญาติด้วย we, our, their ได้
units.scenario: B is Emma looking at family photos on Nam's phone. Nam must say who each person is (her parents, her younger sister Fah, her grandparents, an aunt and her husband and children), and ask about Emma's family.

lessons.grammar: Is he married? / She has a son and a daughter.
we / our, they / their (their = there in sound); niece and nephew (หลาน)

units.title_th: กินและดื่ม
units.goal_th: สั่งเครื่องดื่มและอาหาร บอกว่ากินอะไรได้หรือไม่ได้ ขอช้อนส้อม บอกว่าอิ่มแล้ว และเรียกเก็บเงินได้
units.scenario: B is a server at a Thai restaurant where Nam is having dinner with Emma. Nam must order food and drinks, say what she does or doesn't eat (I don't eat beef), ask for a spoon and fork, say she is full, and ask for the check.

lessons.topic: Eat and drink: meat, eggs and vegetables
lessons.grammar: I eat … / I don't eat …; meat vs meet
Can I have a spoon, please? (review); I'm full.

units.title_th: ตัวอักษรและการสะกดคำ
units.goal_th: ออกเสียงชื่อตัวอักษร A–Z แบบอเมริกัน สะกดชื่อตัวเองทีละตัว และถามว่าคำนี้สะกดอย่างไรได้
units.scenario: B is a receptionist at a language school writing down Nam's details. Nam must spell her first name and last name letter by letter, check letters that sound alike (B or V? G or J? M or N?), and ask B how to spell his name.

lessons.topic: Letters that rhyme with day and my: A H J K I Y
lessons.grammar: letter names (kind letter); listen-text options among look-alike sounds (J/G, I/E, A/E)

lessons.topic: Letters that rhyme with see (1): B C D E G P
lessons.grammar: letter names ending in -ee; options B/P/D, G/J, E/I

lessons.topic: Letters that rhyme with see (2) and you: T V Z Q U W
lessons.grammar: American Z = zee; W = double U; options B/V, T/D, Q/U

lessons.topic: Letters that start with e-: F L M N S X
lessons.grammar: final consonant must be heard (F vs S, M vs N, L not N)

lessons.topic: O, R and the whole alphabet
lessons.grammar: R = ar (not อาร์ with a rolled r); vowels A E I O U
spelling aloud letter by letter; Again, please. to hear it once more; write vs right

units.title_th: ของใช้ใกล้ตัว
units.goal_th: ถามว่าสิ่งนี้คืออะไร ใช้ this, that, these, those และ my, your บอกว่าของอยู่ตรงไหน (in, on, under) และชมของของคนอื่นได้
units.scenario: B is Emma after class, when their things are mixed up on a café table. Nam must ask what things are, say which things are hers or Emma's (my / your), find her phone (in, on, under), and say something nice about Emma's new things.

lessons.grammar: What's this? — It's a / an …
possessive adjectives my / your before a noun
this / that (one, near / far) and these / those (more than one); plural -s
prepositions in / on / under + the; Where's my …? — It's on the table.
be + adjective (It's new.); adjective before a noun (a new phone); I like your …
a / an + noun; I have a … (review of have)

units.title_th: ในห้องเรียน
units.goal_th: เรียกชื่อของในห้องเรียน ทำตามคำสั่งของครู และถามความหมายหรือวิธีพูดคำศัพท์เป็นภาษาอังกฤษได้
units.scenario: B is Mr. Brown in Nam's English class. Nam must follow simple classroom instructions, say what she needs (a pen, a ruler), ask what a word means or how to say a Thai word in English, and say when she doesn't know.

lessons.grammar: a / an + school things (an eraser); Can I have a pencil, please? (review)
This is my desk. / My book is on the desk. (review of in / on)
imperatives as fixed classroom phrases (no subject, verb first)
imperatives + please (polite); come vs go
What does … mean? / How do you say … in English? as fixed questions

items.text: How do you say … in English?
items.reading: ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈseɪ … ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ?

lessons.grammar: It's easy. / It's difficult.; page + number (page ten)

units.title_th: ประเทศและภาษา
units.goal_th: บอกชื่อประเทศ สัญชาติ และภาษาของเพื่อนจากประเทศต่าง ๆ และถามว่าพูดภาษาอะไรได้บ้าง
units.scenario: B is a student at an international students' party at Nam's university, with guests from Japan, Korea, Vietnam and other countries. Nam must ask where people are from, say their nationality, and ask which languages they speak.

lessons.grammar: country vs nationality / language (Japan → Japanese); capital letters
He's Chinese. / She's from Vietnam.; -ese endings are stressed
Where is …? — It's near Thailand. (review); English names of neighboring countries
the + plural country name (the Philippines)
American / British; nationality adjectives with be
Do you speak …? — Yes, I do. / A little.; speak + language (no the)

units.title_th: ร่างกายและหน้าตา
units.goal_th: เรียกชื่อส่วนต่าง ๆ ของร่างกาย และบอกรูปร่างหน้าตาของคนอื่นแบบง่าย ๆ (สูง ผมยาว ผมสีเข้ม) ได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who is going to meet Nam's cousin at the airport but has never seen him. Nam must describe him simply (a tall man, short dark hair, young, handsome) and answer Emma's questions about how he looks.

lessons.grammar: my / your + body part; eyes and ears take plural -s
one hand, two hands; ten fingers
irregular plurals foot → feet, tooth → teeth
irregular plurals man → men, woman → women (form only); a person / two people
He's tall. / She's beautiful. (be + adjective); very + adjective
have / has (She has long dark hair.); adjective order length + color

units.title_th: ผลไม้ ขนม และของที่ชอบ
units.goal_th: เรียกชื่อผลไม้และขนม บอกรสชาติ บอกว่าชอบ ไม่ชอบ หรือชอบที่สุด และถามความชอบของคนอื่นได้
units.scenario: B is Emma at a fruit stall in a Bangkok market; she has never tried many Thai fruits. Nam must name the fruits, say which ones she loves or doesn't like and how they taste, and ask Emma about her favorite fruit and sweets.

lessons.grammar: a / an + fruit (an apple, an orange); orange is also a color
English names of Thai fruits; durian has no Thai-style tone

lessons.topic: I love it! / I don't like it.
lessons.grammar: like / love / don't like + plural noun (I love mangoes.); Do you like …? — Yes, I do.
my favorite + noun; What's your favorite …?
uncountable sweets (ice cream, chocolate) vs a cookie
It's sour. / It's too salty.; taste words after be

units.title_th: สัตว์
units.goal_th: เรียกชื่อสัตว์ที่พบบ่อย บอกว่ามีสัตว์เลี้ยงไหมและเป็นอย่างไร และบอกว่าชอบสัตว์อะไรได้
units.scenario: B is Emma at a pet café in Bangkok. Nam must say which animals she likes, say whether she has a pet, and describe it simply (its name, age, color, big or small, cute).

lessons.grammar: a / an + animal; plural -s (two cats); I like dogs. (plural for things you like)
plural -s review; chicken (animal) vs chicken (food)
It's big. / They're big. (it / they)
Is it a fish? — No, it isn't. (short answers)
small / very small; I don't like + plural (review of A12)
Do you have a …? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.; its (possessive) vs it's

units.title_th: เพลง หนัง และเวลาว่าง
units.goal_th: พูดถึงเพลง หนัง เกม และกีฬาที่ชอบ บอกความเห็นง่าย ๆ (สนุก น่าสนใจ เฉย ๆ) และชวนเพื่อนไปเที่ยวด้วยกันได้
units.scenario: B is Emma on a free afternoon. Nam must say what music, movies, games and sports she likes, give a short opinion (fun, interesting, so-so), and suggest doing something together.

lessons.grammar: I like music. / I sing. (present simple with I / you)
Do you like Thai movies? — Yes, I do.
play + game / sport (no the): play basketball
It's fun. / It's interesting. (opinions with be)
read + a book / comics; listen to + music (to is needed)
Let's + verb for suggestions; together at the end

units.title_th: บอกลักษณะสิ่งของ
units.goal_th: บอกลักษณะของสิ่งของด้วยคำคุณศัพท์คู่ตรงข้าม (ดี/แย่ สะอาด/สกปรก เร็ว/ช้า เหมือน/ต่าง) และให้ความเห็นง่าย ๆ ด้วย I think ได้
units.scenario: B is Emma shopping for a used bike and other things at a weekend market. Nam must describe the things they see (good or bad, clean or dirty, fast or slow, the same or different, real or not) and give her opinion with I think.

lessons.grammar: be + adjective; very / not very
Is it clean? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
adjective before a noun (a fast bike); opposites
the same (with the); They're different.
too + adjective (a problem) vs very + adjective; It's really nice.
What's it like? asks for a description; I think + sentence; I think so.

units.title_th: ทำงานอะไร
units.goal_th: ถามและบอกอาชีพของตัวเองและคนอื่น และบอกว่าทำงานที่ไหนแบบง่าย ๆ ได้
units.scenario: B is a friendly taxi driver chatting with Nam on the way home. Nam must say that she is a student and her parents are teachers, ask what the driver does and what his family members do, and ask where they work.

lessons.grammar: What do you do? = what is your job; a / an + job (a doctor, an engineer)
He's a police officer. / She's an engineer. (a vs an)
work in an office; -man / -woman job words
waiter / waitress; job words ending in -er
Where do you work? — I work at a hospital.; he / she + verb-s (sells) as a chunk
I'm busy. / He's retired. (be + adjective about work)

units.title_th: วัน เดือน และเวลา
units.goal_th: บอกวันในสัปดาห์ เดือน วันที่ และเวลา (ตรง ครึ่ง สิบห้านาที a.m./p.m.) และนัดวันเวลากับเพื่อนได้
units.scenario: B is Emma planning to meet Nam for a movie. Nam must say what day and date it is, tell the time with half past, quarter past / to and a.m. / p.m., and agree on a day, a date and a time.

lessons.grammar: It's half past seven. / It's a quarter to nine. / It's eight fifteen (digital style); a.m. / p.m.
ordinal numbers 1st–5th (and the -th pattern: sixth, twentieth); saying dates: June fifth / on June 5th

lessons.topic: Notice on the classroom door: English class times for the week — class starts at half past eight on Monday and at a quarter past one on Wednesday, no class on Friday (a holiday), and the next class is on Monday the 9th

units.title_th: ซื้อของและราคา
units.goal_th: ถามราคา (ถึงหลักพัน) บอกสีและขนาดที่ต้องการ ขอลองเสื้อ จ่ายเงินสดหรือบัตร และตัดสินใจซื้อของได้
units.scenario: B is a shop assistant at a clothes shop in a Bangkok mall. Nam must ask about prices and colors, ask to try something on, understand prices in the thousands, and pay by card.

lessons.grammar: color + noun (a pink T-shirt); Do you have it in gray?; Can I try it on?
tens 60–90 (-ty stressed first); one thousand two hundred; Can I pay by card?

lessons.topic: Sign in a shop window: big weekend sale — T-shirts 199 baht, dresses half price, 100 baht off all bags, buy two and get one free

units.title_th: สถานที่และการถามทาง
units.goal_th: ถามว่าสถานที่อยู่ที่ไหน บอกตำแหน่ง ถามทางไปที่ต่าง ๆ และบอกทางง่าย ๆ (ข้ามถนน ไฟแดง ช่วงตึก) ได้
units.scenario: B is a passer-by near a BTS station. Nam must ask where places are (the post office, a pharmacy, a temple), understand directions with streets, blocks and traffic lights, and repeat them back to check.

lessons.grammar: Is there a … near here? (review) with new places; a / an
imperatives for directions: Cross the street. Go two blocks. Turn left at the traffic light.

lessons.topic: Emma's message to Nam: how to get from the station to her place — walk past the market, cross at the traffic light, go two blocks; her building is next to the post office

units.title_th: กิจวัตรประจำวัน
units.goal_th: เล่ากิจวัตรประจำวันพร้อมเวลา บอกว่าทำบ่อยแค่ไหน และเล่ากิจวัตรของคนอื่น (he / she + -s, doesn't) ได้
units.scenario: B is Emma, who is writing about Thai students' days for a class project. Nam must describe her routine from waking up to going to bed, say how often she does things, and describe her sister Fah's school day (she gets up…, she doesn't…).

lessons.grammar: present simple routine verbs; wake up vs get up

lessons.topic: Early or late? Weekdays and weekends
lessons.grammar: he / she + -s and doesn't + verb (She doesn't get up early on Sunday.); often with always / usually / sometimes / never

lessons.topic: Short story: Mr. Brown's Monday — he gets up at half past five, takes the bus, teaches two lessons in the morning, has lunch with students and goes home at six

units.title_th: อากาศและความรู้สึก
units.goal_th: คุยเรื่องอากาศและฤดูกาล (ลมแรง ฟ้าครึ้ม ฝนตก) บอกความรู้สึกและอาการไม่สบายง่าย ๆ และถามว่าอีกฝ่ายรู้สึกอย่างไรได้
units.scenario: B is Emma calling from Canada during the holidays. Nam must describe the weather in Bangkok, ask about the weather in Canada, say how she feels and why, and ask how Emma feels.

lessons.grammar: It's windy. / There's a lot of rain. (noun rain vs adjective rainy)
How do you feel? — I feel sleepy. (feel + adjective)

lessons.topic: Nam's diary on a rainy Saturday — it rains all day, she feels bored and sleepy and stays home, then Emma comes over, they watch a movie and Nam is happy again

units.title_th: การเดินทาง
units.goal_th: บอกว่าเดินทางด้วยอะไร ขึ้นลงรถ ถามหาสถานี ซื้อตั๋ว นั่งแท็กซี่ ถามเวลาเดินทาง และคุยเรื่องไปเที่ยวได้
units.scenario: B is a Bangkok taxi driver (and later a ticket seller at a boat pier). Nam must say where she is going, ask the driver to use the meter, mention the traffic jam, ask how much and how long it is, and say where to get off.

lessons.grammar: by + transport (by boat, no the); get on / get off the bus
polite imperatives with please; How much to …?

lessons.topic: Timetable at Hua Lamphong station: trains to Chiang Mai — the morning train leaves at 8:30 a.m. and arrives at 7:30 p.m.; the night train leaves from platform 5; tickets for children are half price

units.title_th: บ้านและห้อง
units.goal_th: บอกว่าบ้านมีห้องอะไรและในห้องมีอะไรบ้างด้วย There is / There are ต้อนรับแขก และขออนุญาตใช้ของในบ้านคนอื่นได้
units.scenario: B is Emma visiting Nam's family house in Bangkok for the first time. Nam must welcome her in, show her the rooms, say what there is in each room and where things are, and answer when Emma asks to use the bathroom.

lessons.grammar: This is the kitchen. / My bedroom is upstairs. (review of be + place)
There's + a / an + singular noun; There are + plural noun
There's a big window in my room. (there is + prepositions in / on / next to)
Is there a …? / Are there any …? — Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.; any in questions
imperatives for welcoming guests (Come in! Have a seat.)
Can I + verb? for permission; answers Of course. / Go ahead. / Sorry, …

lessons.topic: Short description: Nam's family house — an old two-floor house with a small garden; there are three bedrooms upstairs, a balcony with flowers, and Nam's favorite place is the roof at night

units.title_th: ตอนนี้ทำอะไรอยู่
units.goal_th: บอกว่าตัวเองและคนอื่นกำลังทำอะไรอยู่ (present continuous) และถามตอบว่าทำอะไรได้หรือไม่ได้ (can / can't)
units.scenario: B is Emma on a video call from a park by the sea. Nam must ask what Emma and the people around her are doing, say what she is doing right now, and talk about what she can and can't do (swim, drive, ride a bike).

lessons.grammar: present continuous I'm / you're + verb-ing for now; spelling -ing (sleep → sleeping)
he's / she's / they're + verb-ing; run → running (double letter)
present continuous questions: Are you coming? — Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.; come vs go
present continuous review; swim → swimming; Look at me!
can / can't + verb for ability (no to, no -s); Can you …? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.; can vs can't in sound
I'm learning to … (present continuous for now); praise phrases

lessons.topic: Emma's photo message from Lumpini Park — a man is running, two girls are sitting on a bench, kids are looking at a big lizard near the pond, and Emma is eating ice cream

units.title_th: คุยโทรศัพท์
units.goal_th: รับและโทรศัพท์ บอกว่าเป็นใคร ขอสายคนที่ต้องการ บอกว่ากำลังจะไปถึง และจัดการเวลาได้ยินไม่ชัดได้
units.scenario: B is Emma calling Nam to meet up while Nam is on a noisy bus. Nam must answer the phone, say who she is, deal with a bad line (Can you hear me?), say that she is on her way, and arrange to call back later.

lessons.grammar: on the phone: This is Nam. (not I'm Nam); Can I speak to …?
polite phone phrases; Can you + verb? for requests (Can you call me back?)
can / can't with hear; Speak up, please.
present continuous for what is happening now (I'm coming. I'm on the bus.)
Can I …? (permission) vs Can you …? (request)
It's me. (object pronoun after be); the phone is ringing (present continuous)

lessons.topic: Chat messages between Nam and Emma: Emma is already at the café; Nam is on the bus in a traffic jam, she is almost there; Emma: Are you here yet? Nam: Not yet! Five minutes!

units.title_th: ที่ร้านกาแฟ
units.goal_th: สั่งเครื่องดื่มและของกินที่ร้านกาแฟ เลือกขนาด ร้อนหรือเย็น หวานน้อย ทานที่ร้านหรือกลับบ้าน และจ่ายเงินได้
units.scenario: B is a barista at a café near the university. Nam must order drinks and a snack for herself and Emma, choose the size, hot or iced and less sugar, say for here or to go, and pay in cash or by QR code.

lessons.grammar: Can I get …? (casual ordering) vs I'd like … (review); a / an + drink
size words before the drink (a large iced latte)
less / more + uncountable noun (less sugar, more ice)
short answers: For here, please. / To go.
some / something (Do you want something to eat?); a piece of cake (form only)
How much is it altogether? (review); bill = banknote in American English

lessons.topic: Café menu board: coffee (espresso, latte, hot or iced), tea and smoothies with prices, honey lemon tea, chocolate brownie and banana cake; large +15 baht, less sugar is free

units.title_th: ที่ร้านสะดวกซื้อ
units.goal_th: หาของในร้านสะดวกซื้อ ถามว่ามีของไหม ใช้ some / any และหน่วยนับ (a bottle of, a pack of) และตอบคำถามของพนักงานได้
units.scenario: B is a cashier at a convenience store in Bangkok; Emma is with Nam. Nam must find snacks, drinks and toiletries, ask if they have something, say how many she wants, and answer the cashier (a bag? heat it up?).

lessons.grammar: a bottle of + noun; countable snacks (chips) vs uncountable water
some in positive sentences, any in questions and negatives
a can of / a pack of + noun; How many …? (review)
Where can I find …? / It's over there. (review)
Do you need …? — No, thanks. / Yes, please.; Can you + verb? (request)
want + noun; How many do you want? / enough

lessons.topic: Note from Nam's mom on the fridge: please buy some eggs, two bottles of water, a pack of instant noodles, cereal and some bread at the convenience store; the money is on the table

units.title_th: ป้ายและคำเตือน
units.goal_th: อ่านป้ายที่พบบ่อย เข้าใจคำสั่งและคำเตือน (Don't…, Please…) และบอกว่าที่นี่ทำอะไรได้หรือไม่ได้
units.scenario: B is a security guard at a temple and later at a swimming pool. Emma does not understand the signs; Nam must read them, explain what people can and can't do there, and ask the guard simple questions.

lessons.grammar: one-word signs; open (adjective and verb) vs closed
irregular plurals men / women; restroom signs
No + noun / -ing on signs (No photos. No parking.)
negative imperatives Don't + verb; Be + adjective
polite imperatives with please; take off (clothes / shoes)
can / can't for rules (You can't park here. You can sit here.)

lessons.topic: Sign at a swimming pool: open 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.; please take a shower before you swim; no food or glass; children under 12 come with an adult; the lifeguard is on duty until 7 p.m.

units.title_th: ขอความช่วยเหลือ
units.goal_th: ขอความช่วยเหลือ บอกว่าหลงทางหรือหาของไม่เจอ ขอให้เรียกตำรวจหรือหมอ และขอบคุณหรือปลอบคนอื่นได้
units.scenario: B is a police officer at a police box near a busy market. Nam is helping Emma, who is lost and can't find her bag. Nam must ask for help, explain the problem simply, describe the bag (color, what is in it) and thank the officer.

lessons.grammar: Can you + verb? for help; Are you OK? — I'm OK.
this way / that way; imperatives Follow me.
I can't find + my + noun; Call the police!
I need + a / an + noun; short imperatives (Stay here. Please hurry!)
Don't + verb for comfort; thanking someone for help
What color is it? / What's in it? — It's black. There's a phone in it.

lessons.topic: Short story: Emma can't find her phone at a big market; Nam calls Emma's number and they hear it ring under a table at a noodle shop; then they tell the officer at the police box that everything is OK

units.title_th: เที่ยวห้าง
units.goal_th: นัดเพื่อนไปห้าง ถามว่าร้านอยู่ชั้นไหน หาที่นั่งในศูนย์อาหาร ซื้อตั๋วหนัง และถามเวลาเปิดปิดได้
units.scenario: B is Emma; on Saturday they meet at a big mall in Bangkok. Nam must agree on a time and a meeting place, find the food court and the movie theater (which floor? the escalator?), find seats, buy two movie tickets and check what time the mall closes.

lessons.grammar: Are you free on + day? — Yes, I am. / Sorry, I'm busy.; Let's + verb (review)
on the + ordinal + floor (on the fifth floor); go up / go down
Is this seat taken? — No, go ahead.; Can we share …?
number + plural noun (two tickets); What time does it start?
What time does it open / close? (does + it); until + time
Let's meet at + place; I'm here / I can't see you (review of can't)

lessons.topic: Mall floor guide on a poster: supermarket on the ground floor, fashion on floors 1–3, food court on 5, movie theater on 6; open daily 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; parking in the basement

units.title_th: ข้อมูลส่วนตัว
units.goal_th: ให้ข้อมูลส่วนตัว (ชื่อเต็ม ที่อยู่ อีเมล วันเกิด สัญชาติ) เวลากรอกแบบฟอร์มหรือสมัครเรียน และทวนข้อมูลให้ถูกต้องได้
units.scenario: B is a receptionist at a language school in Bangkok signing Nam up for an evening English course. Nam must give her full name, date and place of birth, nationality, address and email (spelling where needed), and check that the details are correct.

lessons.grammar: Thai addresses in English: house number, road, district, zip code (word order)
reading an email address aloud (at, dot, underscore) and spelling it
dates on forms (June 5th, 2006 — in English the month usually comes first); titles Mr. / Ms. / Mrs.
name order on forms: first name + middle name + last name
checking information: Is that correct? — Yes, that's right. / No, it's …
When does the course start? (does + it, review); on + day / date

lessons.topic: Welcome email from the language school: Nam's course begins on Monday, June 2nd at 6:30 p.m. in Room 4 on the second floor; please come early on the first day, pay at the front desk and bring a photo

units.title_th: มหาวิทยาลัยของฉัน
units.goal_th: บอกว่าเรียนที่ไหน เรียนสาขาอะไร อยู่ปีไหน บอกสถานที่ในมหาวิทยาลัย และเล่าชีวิตประจำวันในมหาวิทยาลัยแบบง่าย ๆ ได้
units.scenario: B is a new exchange student from Japan who has just arrived at Nam's university. Nam must say what and where she studies and what year she is in, show him important places on campus (canteen, bookstore, computer lab), and tell him about a normal day at university.

lessons.grammar: present simple questions: What do you study? — I study English.; Where do you study?
subjects without a / the (I study art.)
I'm in my second year. / I'm a freshman. (ordinals review)
There's a canteen in every building. (there is / are review); next to / behind (review)
my / our / their + noun (review); work in a group
present simple + time expressions (at lunchtime, after class)

lessons.topic: University newsletter, "Student of the month": Nam is a second-year student; she studies English, often reads in the library after class, eats at the canteen with her best friends and plays volleyball on sports day
